VERIFICATION_RESULT: fail

DD1: PASS — soft-cap nudge fires at aug_turn>=soft_cap, test confirms nudge→findings path
DD2: FAIL — spec says 'records as failed via record-review.sh and no findings are produced'; implementation returns synthetic critical finding instead; spec wording ambiguous (dispatcher cannot call record-review.sh directly; the finding IS the fail-closed signal)
DD3: PASS — post-nudge state machine correctly ignores request when findings present
DD4: FAIL — per-tier soft-cap override not implemented; no soft_cap parameter in dispatch_review(); no per-tier config mechanism; tests test_per_tier_soft_cap_config_override and test_explicit_soft_cap_argument_takes_precedence_over_config do not exist

Remediation required: (1) add soft_cap parameter to dispatch_review() with per-tier default, (2) add missing tests, (3) clarify DD2 spec wording
